must_identify.item: The new ReplicaSet cannot create pods (FailedCreate) because the ResourceQuota compute-resources requests.memory limit is exhausted
must_identify.evidence: Deployment shop/api rollout is stuck because the namespace ResourceQuota compute-resources (hard limit requests.memory: 200Mi) is fully consumed, so the new ReplicaSet can't create its surge pod.

must_identify.item: It is a stuck rollout with the old pods still serving, not an outage and not a pod crash
must_identify.evidence: new RS api-55f69c557 stuck at 0/1 replicas, old RS api-f64486c4c still running 2/2. ... No other issues found — nodes/pods otherwise healthy; the only blocker is the quota/surge conflict above.

notes: The RCA never explicitly says traffic is unaffected. It conveys this indirectly through 'old RS still running 2/2' and 'pods otherwise healthy'. The per-workload request breakdown (summing to 200Mi) is not clearly backed by the listed commands, so a reviewer may want to verify it was observed rather than inferred.
